toegepas.voor: Jou skoene raak elke jaar te klein en ons noem daardie groter word groei.
toegepas.na: Jou skoene raak elke jaar te klein omdat jy groter word. Ons noem dit groei.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'daardie groter word' points back to something the sentence never says; naming it makes the reference clear, and the original also lacked the AWS comma before 'en'.
toegepas.fout: 'daardie groter word' points back to something the sentence never states, so the opening reads awkwardly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal says plainly what the original only implied (shoes get too small because you grow, and that is called growth) without adding a new fact.

toegepas.voor: 'n Baba kan nie loop nie en later hardloop jy.
toegepas.na: As baba kon jy nie loop nie, maar later kon jy hardloop.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The subject jumps from 'n baba' to 'jy' mid-sentence; one subject and a contrastive 'maar' with the AWS comma reads naturally.
toegepas.fout: The subject jumps from 'n baba' to 'jy' in one sentence, which makes a reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: One subject and a contrastive 'maar' give the same contrast (could not walk, later runs) in natural Afrikaans.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'deur stadiums gaan' is the natural Afrikaans idiom; 'loop deur' suggests physically walking through.
toegepas.fout: 'loop deur 'n paar stadiums' is a loose, less natural expression for passing through stages.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'deur stadiums gaan' is the natural Afrikaans expression and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences, each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both 'Ons noem' and 'die jong plantjie ... is' are full clauses, so the AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'waai' used transitively without a particle is awkward; 'dra' is natural and parallels 'n By dra dit' just before.
toegepas.fout: Transitive 'waai die stuifmeel' with no particle or destination is awkward.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'dra die wind die stuifmeel' is natural, matches 'n By dra dit' and keeps the meaning and the qualifiers 'baie' and 'party'.

toegepas.voor: het nie een van die drie nie
toegepas.na: het geeneen van die drie nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'nie een van die drie nie' can be read as 'lacks one of the three'; 'geeneen' says unambiguously that they have none.
toegepas.fout: 'het nie een van die drie nie' can be misread as lacking only one of the three.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'geeneen van die drie nie' says unambiguously that a fern and a moss have none of them, which is what the original meant.

toegepas.voor: Die verspreiding van saad bring die sade weg van die moederplant af.
toegepas.na: Met die verspreiding van saad kom die sade weg van die moederplant af.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'bring ... weg ... af' is an unnatural combination; 'kom weg van ... af' is idiomatic and matches the glossary entry.
toegepas.fout: 'bring ... weg van ... af' is an unnatural combination.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal is idiomatic, keeps the meaning and matches the lesson's own glossary wording for seed dispersal.

toegepas.voor: eet party vrugte en die wind
toegepas.na: eet party vrugte, en die wind
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences, each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n Dier eet' and 'die wind waai' are full clauses, so the AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.blok: Die hoender se drie stadiums ná die eier
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'dus' means 'therefore', but the phrase only renames the two sexes, so 'dit wil sê' is the right connector.
toegepas.fout: 'dus' (therefore) is the wrong connector for a phrase that only renames the two sexes.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'dit wil sê' is the correct connector for a renaming, and nothing else changes.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences, each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Sommige gewerwelde diere lê' and 'by ander word die kleintjies ... gebore' are full clauses; the protected 'gewerwelde diere' is untouched.

toegepas.blok: Die siklus begin weer van voor af
toegepas.voor: Een geslag gee so aanleiding tot die volgende geslag.
toegepas.na: So kom die volgende geslag uit een geslag voort.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'aanleiding gee tot' is formal and abstract for Grade 5; 'voortkom uit' is plainer and keeps the meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'gee aanleiding tot' copies English 'give rise to' and is too formal and abstract for this reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'voortkom uit' is plain Afrikaans and keeps the same relation between one generation and the next.

toegepas.blok: Die dood kan op enige stadium kom
toegepas.voor: lewensiklus plaasvind en nie net aan die einde nie
toegepas.na: lewensiklus kom, nie net aan die einde nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Death 'kom' is more natural than 'plaasvind', matches the heading, and the comma reads better before the 'nie net' contrast.
toegepas.fout: 'plaasvind' is wooden for death in a Grade 5 text.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'kom' is natural, echoes the heading and keeps 'op enige stadium' and 'nie net aan die einde nie' intact.

toegepas.blok: Die dood kan op enige stadium kom
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences, each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Baie sade ontkiem' and 'n slak vreet' are full clauses, so the AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.blok: Baie diere sorg vir hulle kleintjies
toegepas.na: om te groei en te ontwikkel
toegepas.rede_vinder: In a coordinated om-te construction, standard Afrikaans repeats 'te' before the second verb.
toegepas.fout: The second verb in the coordinated om-te construction lacks its 'te'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Standard Afrikaans repeats 'te', and the meaning is unchanged.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Using the bare verb 'Ontwikkel' as a subject is wooden; the verb in its normal role says the same thing.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Ontwikkel is wanneer' is the lesson's ordinary way of introducing a term; the proposal turns the definition into a plain statement and loses the term-naming function.

laat_vaar.voor: volle grootte. Hulle ontwikkel wel hulle hele
laat_vaar.na: volle grootte, maar hulle ontwikkel hulle hele
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The contrast carried by 'wel' reads more smoothly as one sentence joined with 'maar' and the AWS comma.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Hulle ontwikkel wel' already carries the contrast naturally; joining the sentences with 'maar' is a lateral move that makes the sentence longer.

laat_vaar.voor: ontwikkel die plant en die dier verder
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'die plant en die dier' refers to no particular plant or animal; the general form matches 'Elke plant en dier' in the first sentence.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'die plant en die dier' reads acceptably as a reference back to 'Elke plant en dier', and the proposal swaps a conjunction and stacks two 'of's without clearly improving the sentence.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'swel tot' is not idiomatic; 'swel en word' says it plainly.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'swel tot 'n vrug' is acceptable Afrikaans, and the proposal is only a different way of saying it.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'klomp' is colloquial for a definition; 'groep' is the neutral word.
na_skrywer.fout: 'een klomp ouers' is colloquial and loose in a glossary definition.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The point is real, but this is a glossary definition and the change goes beyond spelling or grammar, so the writer must decide it for every lesson that shares it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
